title: Sync: File Backup & Cloud Sync
summary: Backup, restore & sync files to Drive, Dropbox, S3, OneDrive, Box & USB
description:
Your files, everywhere. Always in sync.

Sync backs up, restores, and syncs your files across local storage, USB drives, and 5 major cloud services — all from one app, on every platform.

🔄 5 sync modes · ☁️ 5 cloud services · 📱 4 platforms

☁️ 5 CLOUD SERVICES
Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, and Amazon S3 — connect as many as you need, all in one place.

🔄 5 SYNC MODES
Full Sync, Backup, Restore, Backup Sync, and Restore Sync. Granular control over exactly how your files flow, not just a single one-size-fits-all sync.

📁 BUILT-IN FILE MANAGER
Browse, upload, download, rename, and delete files across every connected drive — no need for a separate file manager app.

🌐 WI-FI FILE SHARING
Turn your device into a local web server and share files over Wi-Fi — no cloud upload required.

💾 USB & EXTERNAL DRIVE SUPPORT
Sync directly to and from removable drives and external storage — a desktop-grade feature, on mobile.

📱 TRULY CROSS-PLATFORM
iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows. Set up your workflow once, use it everywhere.

⚡ INCREMENTAL SYNC
Only changed files transfer, so repeat syncs are fast and light on bandwidth.

🗂️ TASK-BASED WORKFLOWS
Create multiple sync tasks, each with its own sources and destinations — built for power users who need more than one simple sync job.
